If you sell digital products, these are 3 legal documents you need to know about, and most sellers completely overlook number 3 👀 1️⃣ Digital Product Purchase Agreement This can establish the terms of the purchase, including restrictions on sharing or reselling your digital product and other important purchase terms. 2️⃣ Website/Store Terms & Conditions Your Terms & Conditions establish the rules for your online business and can address things like refunds, intellectual property, and limitations of liability. 3️⃣ Content Usage License If a brand or client pays to use your videos, templates, graphics, courses, or other content, a content usage license can clearly define how they can use it, where, for how long, and what happens if they go beyond those rights. Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. 💅🏾 And no, you don't necessarily need to spend hundreds on legal fees just to get foundational documents in place. Instead of watching Netflix tonight… start building something of your own. 💻✨ Here’s how I’d create a digital product using ChatGPT and Canva—step by step. 👇 📌 SAVE these prompts for later! 1️⃣ BUILD YOUR OUTLINE Copy into ChatGPT: “Create an outline for a 10–12 page guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Give me a section-by-section structure with a one-sentence summary for each.” 💡 Choose a specific problem you know how to help someone solve. 2️⃣ WRITE YOUR CONTENT “Write a short, conversational section about [SUBTOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Keep it simple, include one practical example, and stay under 250 words.” ✨ Add your own voice, experience, and tips. Check the facts and make sure the advice is useful! 3️⃣ GIVE IT A NAME “Give me 10 name ideas for a guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Mix clear, descriptive titles with catchy options. Avoid clichés.” 4️⃣ DESIGN IT IN CANVA 🎨 Use Canva’s free plan, search “ebook template,” choose free elements, add your content, and export as a PDF. 5️⃣ GET IT READY TO SELL 🛍️ Choose a storefront, such as Etsy, Stan Store, or Beacons, and check its fees and requirements. Then ask ChatGPT: “Write a four-sentence sales description for [PRODUCT] for [AUDIENCE]. Explain how it helps them [OUTCOME]. Keep it conversational, specific, and trustworthy—no hype or income promises.” That’s a digital product ready to sell and promote. 💰 The math: 100 sales at $29 = $2,900 in gross sales, before fees and taxes.
